name: openduo
description: GitLab Duo Agentic Chat for Federal Enterprise

enumDescriptions: REST endpoint (/api/v4/chat/completions) — for self-managed GitLab EE instances
openduo.chatProvider.description: Which GitLab Duo Chat API to use. Use 'rest' for self-managed EE, 'graphql' for GitLab.com.

openduo.rejectUnauthorized.description: Validate SSL/TLS certificates when connecting to GitLab. Disable for self-signed certificates not in the system trust store. WARNING: disabling this reduces connection security.

openduo.customCaCertPath.description: Absolute path to a PEM-formatted CA certificate file to trust when connecting to GitLab. Useful for enterprise environments with internal certificate authorities.

openduo.debug.networkErrors.description: Log detailed diagnostics for network connection errors (DNS resolution, connection refused, timeouts).

openduo.debug.sslErrors.description: Log detailed diagnostics for SSL/TLS certificate validation errors.

openduo.debug.proxyErrors.description: Log detailed diagnostics for HTTP proxy configuration and tunnel errors.

openduo.debug.apiErrors.description: Log detailed diagnostics for GitLab API errors including full HTTP status codes and response bodies.

openduo.debug.webSocketErrors.description: Log detailed diagnostics for WebSocket/ActionCable connection and framing errors.

openduo.debug.serverErrors.description: Log detailed diagnostics for internal server process errors (startup failures, IPC issues, crashes).
